title: Banjarmasin War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Banjarmasin War", at revision 1380699460, opens: "The Banjarmasin War (1859–1863) was a war of succession in the Sultanate of Banjarmasin, as well as a colonial war for the restoration of Dutch authority in the eastern and southern section of Borneo." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q368594, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "war between the Dutch Empire and the pro-Antasari faction". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
